description: dd_colouring §5 unit test 1 on a sample of the gamut: the round trip sRGB → linear → OKLab → linear → sRGB in f32 through render::colour::space, at every 8-bit sRGB code that is a multiple of 5 on each channel (52 codes per channel, 140608 colours, black, white, the primaries and the secondaries among them). The lattice oklab_transcription's round trips, compositions and GPU checks run on. A sample: its maximum is below full_gamut.json's, which REQ-COL-049's proposal is made from. Recorded: the CPU measurement on this lattice. On the GPU (Metal, Apple silicon), oklab_transcription_gpu_round_trip measured 2.431e-6 linear and 2.370e-5 encoded over the same lattice.
